question: If the curved surface area of a cylinder is 880 cm², then the product of its height and radius is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of cylinder = 2πrh

Given 2πrh = 880

r × h = 880 ÷ (2 × 22 ÷ 7)

r × h = 880 × (7 ÷ 44) = 140

**∴ The correct answer is 140 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Curved surface area of the cylinder = 880 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Curved surface area of a cylinder = 2πrh

Where r = radius and h = height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cffb7a7bda28ed36359846504ccf741387bf0b8e2fee4f6cd6382e059478b841.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × r × h = 880

⇒ (44 ÷ 7) × r × h = 880

⇒ r × h = 880 × (7 ÷ 44)

⇒ r × h = 20 × 7

⇒ r × h = 140 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 140 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(r + h).

Volume of Cylinder

The volume represents the total space occupied by the cylinder: V = πr²h.

Surface Area of Cone

For a cone with base radius r and slant height l, the Curved Surface Area = πrl and Total Surface Area = πr(r + l).
